segments.sn40.2:1.4: ‘idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn40.2:1.6: So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn40.2:1.7: Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato vitakkasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
segments.sn40.2:2.1: “Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca –
segments.sn40.2:2.3: Mā, brāhmaṇa, dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ pamādo, dutiye jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, dutiye jhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, dutiye jhāne cittaṃ samādahā’ti.
segments.sn40.2:2.4: So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.sn40.2:2.5: Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya –
segments.sn40.2:2.6: ‘satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ patto’ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya –

lines: Tassa hi paṭhamajjhānavuṭṭhitassa pañca nīvaraṇāni santato upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
Tenassa taṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ hānabhāgiyaṃ nāma ahosi.
Taṃ pamādaṃ ñatvā satthā “mā pamādo”ti ovādaṃ adāsi.
332-339. Kāmasahagatesu saññāmanasikāresu upaṭṭhahantesu byāpādādisahagatāpi saññāmanasikārā yathāpaccayaṃ upaṭṭhahantiyevāti vuttaṃ “kāmasahagatāti pañcanīvaraṇasahagatā”ti.
Pahīnāvasesā cettha nīvaraṇā veditabbā, tasmā pañcaggahaṇaṃ na kattabbaṃ.
